headline: The 100,000-Card AI Cluster Battle Begins: Domestic Computing Power Track Surges as Major Manufacturers Rush to Buy Compute; JD Plans to Order 100,000 Moore Threads GPUs, Brokerages Declare "Domestic Cards + Supernodes" an Inevitable Trend
summary: Chinese domestic computing power stocks rose as JD plans to order 100,000 Moore Threads GPUs. Brokerages describe domestic cards and supernodes as an inevitable trend.
why: JD.com is a major Chinese e-commerce and logistics company, and Moore Threads is a Chinese GPU designer, so their AI computing purchases signal demand for domestic chips.
why_moved: The report says the domestic computing power sector surged on news of large GPU purchases by major manufacturers, including JD's plan to order 100,000 Moore Threads GPUs.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: 十万卡AI集群大战开启，国产算力赛道风起雨涌，各大头部厂商纷纷出手大买算力！京东拟下单摩尔线程十万张GPU，有券商高呼“国产卡+超节点”是必然趋势
